body.message:
Hi, we’re looking for a furnished 2-bedroom apartment in Dubai for a 60-night stay from 1 January to 2 March 2027.

Our main requirements are:

• Maximum 10-minute walk to a Dubai Metro station
• Easy Metro access to Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall
• 2 bedrooms
• Fully equipped kitchen and washing machine
• Reliable high-speed Wi-Fi
• Swimming pool
• All utilities included

We’re flexible on the exact area and don’t require daily housekeeping.

As we’re booking for a full 60 nights, could you please send me your best long-stay rate and any apartments you have available?

Please quote the total price for the full 60 nights including VAT, tourism fees, cleaning/admin charges and any other compulsory fees, and also confirm any refundable security deposit separately.

Thank you.
Jason
